resources.string: Two ways to merge: falling stars or sliding ceramic pucks
Aim, slide and merge ceramic pucks on a wooden board
Touch the launch strip, pull back, release
Choose a clear spot and pull down to aim
Start a new board? Points earned on this board will be converted into neutrinos.
No room left on the launch line

Touch a clear spot on the strip at the bottom of the board. Pull your finger backwards to choose your direction and power, then release. A short pull makes a gentle shot; a longer pull sends the puck further. To cancel a shot, bring your finger back to its starting point.

Pucks glide, slow down, bounce off the rails and push one another. Two matching ranks merge into a larger puck. Chain several merges in the same shot for a multiplier of up to ×8. Two rank XI pucks produce a smaller rank XII puck; two rank XII pucks disappear for a bonus and free up space.

Wait for the pucks to stop before shooting again. The dotted guide estimates the path up to the first puck; it includes rail bounces. The game ends when there is no space left to place your next puck on the launch line.

Your board is saved when you leave. Best scores are separate from Accretion. Earn one neutrino per %1$d points, paid when the game ends or you start a new board.
